parameters.query: select id, employee_id, draft_json, status, reviewer from reports where id = $1::uuid

with upd as (
  update reports
     set status = $2,
         final_json = $3::jsonb,
         reviewer = $4,
         approved_at = now()
   where id = $1::uuid
  returning id
)
insert into audit_log (report_id, actor, action, diff)
select id, $4, $2, $5::jsonb from upd
returning report_id, action, actor, at
